# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
obj_is_vector = function(x){TRUE}

all.stats <- bind_rows(lapply(paste0("stats/e", 1:4, "_stats.csv"), read.csv))
all.descriptives <- bind_rows(lapply(paste0("stats/e", 1:4, "_descriptives.csv"), read.csv))
trials <- bind_rows(lapply(paste0("stats/e", 1:4, "_trials.csv"), read.csv))
survey <- bind_rows(lapply(paste0("stats/e", 1:4, "_survey.csv"), read.csv))

```

# Hypothesis table

```{r}

hypothesis.table <- all.stats %>%
  filter(grepl("^H", hypothesis), stat_type %in% c("t", "z")) %>%  # drops LRT sensitivity rows
  mutate(
    stat_fmt = ifelse(stat_type == "t",
                      sprintf("b = %.1f, t(%.0f) = %.2f", b, df, stat),
                      sprintf("b = %.2f, z = %.2f", b, stat)),
    p_fmt = ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < .001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p))
  ) %>%
  select(experiment, hypothesis, measure, stat_fmt, p_fmt, n)

hypothesis.table

write.csv(hypothesis.table, "stats/hypothesis_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Pooled truth advantage (E1 + E2 first trials)

```{r}

first.disagree <- trials %>%
  filter(experiment %in% c("E1", "E2"), trial_type == "intro",
         trial_index == 0, participant_persuader_disagree == TRUE)

first.disagree %>%
  group_by(experiment, persuader_correct) %>%
  summarize(
    persuader_success = mean(persuader_success),
    confidence_change = mean(confidence_change),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

first.disagree %>%
  group_by(persuader_correct) %>%
  summarize(
    persuader_success = mean(persuader_success),
    confidence_change = mean(confidence_change),
    n = n()
  )

```

```{r}

m.truth.pooled.cc <- lmer(confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + experiment + (1 | question_id),
            data = first.disagree)
summary(m.truth.pooled.cc)

```

```{r}

m.truth.pooled.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + experiment + (1 | question_id),
            family = "binomial",
            data = first.disagree)
summary(m.truth.pooled.ps)

```

# Individual differences

## Susceptibility to Persuasion (StP-II), Experiments 1--3

```{r id-covariates}
id_cov <- function(d) d %>% mutate(
  confidence_pre_10 = confidence_pre / 10,
  cell = droplevels(interaction(experiment, intro_condition,
                                coalesce(as.character(feedback_condition), "none"),
                                coalesce(as.character(hint_condition), "none"),
                                coalesce(as.character(interaction_type), "llm"), drop = TRUE)))
ID_RHS_BASE <- "persuader_correct + confidence_pre_10 + trial_type"   # single-experiment fits
ID_RHS <- paste(ID_RHS_BASE, "+ experiment")                           # pooled fits
ID_RHS_CELL <- paste(ID_RHS_BASE, "+ cell")                            # participant-variance model only
GL_CTRL <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
# bobyqa first; if lme4 flags non-convergence, refit with Nelder-Mead and keep
# whichever fit has no convergence messages (else the lower deviance)
glmer_safe <- function(f, data) {
  m1 <- glmer(f, data = data, family = binomial, control = GL_CTRL)
  if (length(m1@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages) == 0) return(m1)
  m2 <- glmer(f, data = data, family = binomial,
              control = glmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
  if (length(m2@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages) == 0 || deviance(m2) < deviance(m1)) m2 else m1
}
```

```{r stp-pooled}
stp_resp <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityResponse.csv")
stp_q <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityQuestion.csv")
stp_keep <- stp_resp %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>% summarize(rt = mean(reaction_time)) %>%
  filter(rt > 4000) %>% pull(participant_id)
stp_total <- stp_resp %>%
  filter(participant_id %in% stp_keep) %>%
  left_join(stp_q %>% select(item_id, category), by = c("question_id" = "item_id")) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, category) %>%
  summarize(score = mean(scoring * response), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>% summarize(stp = mean(score))

stp.disagree <- trials %>%
  filter(experiment %in% c("E1", "E2", "E3"), participant_persuader_disagree) %>%
  id_cov() %>%
  inner_join(stp_total, by = "participant_id") %>%
  mutate(stp_z = as.numeric(scale(stp)))
cat(sprintf("%d disagreement trials from %d participants (SD of StP = %.2f)\n",
            nrow(stp.disagree), n_distinct(stp.disagree$participant_id), sd(stp_total$stp[stp_total$participant_id %in% stp.disagree$participant_id])))
table(stp.disagree$experiment)

# PAPER models: standard covariates (see id-covariates)
m.stp.ps <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ stp_z +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
                  family = "binomial", data = stp.disagree, control = GL_CTRL)
summary(m.stp.ps)$coefficients["stp_z", ]
m.stp.cc <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ stp_z +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
                 data = stp.disagree)
summary(m.stp.cc)$coefficients["stp_z", ]
```

```{r stp-pooled-unadjusted}
m.stp.ps.raw <- glmer(persuader_success ~ stp_z + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                      family = "binomial", data = stp.disagree, control = GL_CTRL)
summary(m.stp.ps.raw)$coefficients["stp_z", ]
m.stp.cc.raw <- lmer(confidence_change ~ stp_z + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id), data = stp.disagree)
summary(m.stp.cc.raw)$coefficients["stp_z", ]
```

```{r stp-by-experiment}
stp.by.exp <- bind_rows(lapply(c("E1", "E2", "E3"), function(e) {
  d <- stp.disagree %>% filter(experiment == e)
  m <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ stp_z +", ID_RHS_BASE, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
             family = "binomial", data = d, control = GL_CTRL)
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  data.frame(experiment = e, n = nrow(d), b = co["stp_z", 1], se = co["stp_z", 2], z = co["stp_z", 3], p = co["stp_z", 4])
}))
stp.by.exp
```

## StP-II subscales, and persuader success in percentage points

```{r stp-subscales}
STP_LABELS <- c(
  "total" = "Total StP-II",
  "attitudes towards advertising" = "Positive attitude to advertising",
  "consistency" = "Need for consistency",
  "need for cognition" = "Low need for cognition",
  "need for unique choice" = "Need for unique choice",
  "premeditation" = "Low premeditation",
  "risk preferences" = "Risk preference",
  "self-control" = "Low self-control",
  "sensation seeking" = "Sensation seeking",
  "similarity" = "Need for similarity",
  "social influence" = "Susceptibility to social influence")
stp_sub <- stp_resp %>%
  filter(participant_id %in% stp_keep) %>%
  left_join(stp_q %>% select(item_id, category), by = c("question_id" = "item_id")) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, category) %>%
  summarize(score = mean(scoring * response), .groups = "drop")
ame_scale <- function(m) { f <- fitted(m); 100 * mean(f * (1 - f)) }
fit_stp <- function(d, lab, set) {
  d <- d %>% mutate(z = as.numeric(scale(score)))
  d <- d %>% mutate(cell = droplevels(cell))
  mp <- glmer_safe(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ z +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), d)
  ma <- mp
  mc <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ z +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), data = d)
  cp <- summary(mp)$coefficients["z", ]; ca <- summary(ma)$coefficients["z", ]
  cc <- summary(mc)$coefficients["z", ]; k <- ame_scale(mp); ka <- ame_scale(ma)
  tibble(set = set, label = lab, n = nrow(d), n_ppt = n_distinct(d$participant_id),
         ps_b = cp[1], ps_se = cp[2], ps_z = cp[3], ps_p = cp[4],
         ps_pp = cp[1] * k, ps_pp_lo = (cp[1] - 1.96 * cp[2]) * k, ps_pp_hi = (cp[1] + 1.96 * cp[2]) * k,
         ps_adj_b = ca[1], ps_adj_p = ca[4], ps_adj_pp = ca[1] * ka,
         cc_b = cc[1], cc_lo = cc[1] - 1.96 * cc[2], cc_hi = cc[1] + 1.96 * cc[2],
         cc_t = cc[4], cc_p = cc[5],
         conv_warn = length(mp@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages) + length(ma@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages))
}
base <- trials %>%
  filter(experiment %in% c("E1", "E2", "E3"), participant_persuader_disagree) %>%
  id_cov()
sub_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(names(STP_LABELS)[-1], function(cat) {
  d <- base %>% inner_join(stp_sub %>% filter(category == cat) %>% select(participant_id, score),
                           by = "participant_id")
  fit_stp(d, STP_LABELS[[cat]], "subscale")
})) %>%
  mutate(ps_p_bh = p.adjust(ps_p, "BH"), cc_p_bh = p.adjust(cc_p, "BH"))
# total (pooled + per experiment; common z over the pooled sample, as in stp-by-experiment)
tot <- base %>% inner_join(stp_total %>% rename(score = stp), by = "participant_id")
tot_rows <- bind_rows(
  fit_stp(tot, "Pooled", "experiment") %>% mutate(ps_p_bh = NA, cc_p_bh = NA),
  bind_rows(lapply(c("E1", "E2", "E3"), function(e) {
    zc <- tot %>% mutate(score = as.numeric(scale(score)))   # pooled scaling
    d <- zc %>% filter(experiment == e)
    # keep the pooled SD: refit with z = pooled-z (scale() inside fit_stp would re-standardize)
    d <- d %>% mutate(cell = droplevels(cell))
    mp <- glmer_safe(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ score +", ID_RHS_BASE, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), d)
    mc <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ score +", ID_RHS_BASE, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), data = d)
    cp <- summary(mp)$coefficients["score", ]; cc <- summary(mc)$coefficients["score", ]; k <- ame_scale(mp)
    tibble(set = "experiment", label = e, n = nrow(d), n_ppt = n_distinct(d$participant_id),
           ps_b = cp[1], ps_se = cp[2], ps_z = cp[3], ps_p = cp[4],
           ps_pp = cp[1] * k, ps_pp_lo = (cp[1] - 1.96 * cp[2]) * k, ps_pp_hi = (cp[1] + 1.96 * cp[2]) * k,
           cc_b = cc[1], cc_lo = cc[1] - 1.96 * cc[2], cc_hi = cc[1] + 1.96 * cc[2],
           cc_t = cc[4], cc_p = cc[5], conv_warn = length(mp@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages))
  })))
stp_coefs <- bind_rows(tot_rows, sub_rows %>% bind_rows(
  fit_stp(tot, "Total StP-II", "subscale") %>% mutate(ps_p_bh = NA, cc_p_bh = NA)))
stp_coefs %>%
  select(set, label, n_ppt, ps_b, ps_p, ps_pp, ps_pp_lo, ps_pp_hi, ps_p_bh, ps_adj_pp, ps_adj_p,
         cc_b, cc_p, cc_p_bh, conv_warn) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  as.data.frame()
write.csv(stp_coefs, "stats/stp_coefs.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Subscale intercorrelations (participant level) -- are the top subscales one factor?
stp_sub %>% pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = score) %>%
  select(-participant_id) %>% cor(use = "pairwise") %>% round(2)
```

```{r stp-nfc-truth}
nfc <- stp_sub %>% filter(category == "need for cognition") %>% select(participant_id, nfc = score)
nfc_d <- base %>% inner_join(nfc, by = "participant_id") %>% mutate(nfc_z = as.numeric(scale(nfc)))
clean_nfc <- nfc_d %>% filter(trial_index == 0 | (trial_type == "final" & experiment != "E3"))
m.nfc.truth.clean <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ nfc_z * persuader_correct +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
                           family = "binomial", data = clean_nfc %>% mutate(cell = droplevels(cell)), control = GL_CTRL)
m.nfc.truth.all <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ nfc_z * persuader_correct +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
                         family = "binomial", data = nfc_d, control = GL_CTRL)
round(summary(m.nfc.truth.clean)$coefficients, 3)
round(summary(m.nfc.truth.all)$coefficients, 3)
# does low NFC go with lower initial confidence / accuracy? (participant-level)
nfc_d %>% group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarize(nfc = first(nfc), conf = mean(confidence_pre)) %>%
  with(cor.test(nfc, conf))
```

## Self-rated domain expertise, Experiments 1--4

```{r expertise-pooled}
questions.sub <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Question.csv") %>% select(question_id = id, subcategory)
expertise.ratings <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Participant.csv") %>%
  select(participant_id = id, physics, logic, probability)
add_expertise <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    left_join(questions.sub, by = "question_id") %>%
    left_join(expertise.ratings, by = "participant_id") %>%
    mutate(expertise = case_when(subcategory == "physics" ~ physics,
                                 subcategory == "logic" ~ logic,
                                 subcategory == "probability" ~ probability)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(expertise))
}

expertise.final <- trials %>%
  filter(trial_type == "final", participant_persuader_disagree) %>%
  add_expertise() %>%
  id_cov()
cat(sprintf("%d final disagreement trials with a matching expertise rating\n", nrow(expertise.final)))
table(expertise.final$experiment)

# Final disagreement trials, pooled (experiment as covariate; question random intercept as in e1.Rmd)
# PAPER models: standard covariates minus trial_type (finals only; one per participant,
# so no participant intercept)
EXP_RHS <- "persuader_correct + confidence_pre_10 + experiment + interaction_type"  # E4 includes human persuaders
m.exp.ps <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ expertise +", EXP_RHS, "+ (1 | question_id)")),
                  family = "binomial", data = expertise.final, control = GL_CTRL)
summary(m.exp.ps)$coefficients["expertise", ]
m.exp.cc <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ expertise +", EXP_RHS, "+ (1 | question_id)")), data = expertise.final)
summary(m.exp.cc)$coefficients["expertise", ]
# reference only (not reported): experiment-only fit
m.exp.ps.raw <- glmer(persuader_success ~ expertise + experiment + (1 | question_id),
                      family = "binomial", data = expertise.final, control = GL_CTRL)
summary(m.exp.ps.raw)$coefficients["expertise", ]
```

```{r expertise-pooled-all}
expertise.all <- trials %>%
  filter(participant_persuader_disagree) %>%
  add_expertise() %>%
  id_cov()
m.exp.ps.all <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ expertise + interaction_type +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)")),
                      family = "binomial", data = expertise.all, control = GL_CTRL)
summary(m.exp.ps.all)$coefficients["expertise", ]
cat(sprintf("%d disagreement trials, %d participants\n", nrow(expertise.all), n_distinct(expertise.all$participant_id)))
```

```{r expertise-by-domain}
exp_dom <- bind_rows(lapply(c("physics", "logic", "probability"), function(dom) {
  d <- expertise.all %>% filter(subcategory == dom) %>% mutate(cell = droplevels(cell))
  m <- glmer_safe(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ expertise + interaction_type +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), d)
  mc <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ expertise + interaction_type +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), data = d)
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients["expertise", ]; cc <- summary(mc)$coefficients["expertise", ]; f <- fitted(m)
  tibble(domain = dom, n = nrow(d), n_ppt = n_distinct(d$participant_id),
         ps_b = co[1], ps_z = co[3], ps_p = co[4], ps_pp = 100 * co[1] * mean(f * (1 - f)),
         cc_b = cc[1], cc_p = cc[5], conv_warn = length(m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages))
}))
as.data.frame(exp_dom)
m.dom1 <- glmer_safe(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ expertise * subcategory + interaction_type +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), expertise.all)
m.dom0 <- glmer_safe(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ expertise + subcategory + interaction_type +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), expertise.all)
anova(m.dom0, m.dom1)
write.csv(exp_dom, "stats/expertise_by_domain.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r expertise-accuracy}
survey.expertise <- survey %>% add_expertise()
m.exp.acc <- glmer(accuracy ~ expertise + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
                   family = "binomial", data = survey.expertise, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(m.exp.acc)
bind_rows(lapply(c("E1", "E2", "E3", "E4"), function(e) {

             family = "binomial", data = survey.expertise %>% filter(experiment == e),

  co <- summary(m)$coefficients

}))
m.exp.conf <- lmer(confidence ~ expertise + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id), data = survey.expertise)
summary(m.exp.conf)
```

## How much do participants differ? Variance and demographics

```{r id-variance}
p.demo <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Participant.csv") %>%
  transmute(participant_id = id, age = 2025 - as.numeric(birth_year), gender, native_english)
iv <- trials %>%
  filter(participant_persuader_disagree, is.na(hint_condition) | hint_condition != "Hint",
         is.na(interaction_type) | interaction_type != "human_human") %>%
  id_cov() %>% left_join(p.demo, by = "participant_id")
cat(sprintf("%d trials, %d participants; trials per participant:\n", nrow(iv), n_distinct(iv$participant_id)))
print(summary(as.vector(table(iv$participant_id))))
f.iv <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", ID_RHS_CELL, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)"))
m.iv1 <- glmer(f.iv, data = iv, family = binomial, control = GL_CTRL)
m.iv0 <- glmer(update(f.iv, . ~ . - (1 | participant_id)), data = iv, family = binomial, control = GL_CTRL)
print(VarCorr(m.iv1)); print(anova(m.iv0, m.iv1))
sd.p <- attr(VarCorr(m.iv1)$participant_id, "stddev"); sd.q <- attr(VarCorr(m.iv1)$question_id, "stddev")
eta.q <- predict(m.iv1, re.form = ~ (1 | question_id))
id_variance <- tibble(
  sd_participant = sd.p, sd_question = sd.q,
  icc_participant = sd.p^2 / (sd.p^2 + sd.q^2 + pi^2 / 3),
  icc_question = sd.q^2 / (sd.p^2 + sd.q^2 + pi^2 / 3),
  lrt_chisq = anova(m.iv0, m.iv1)$Chisq[2], lrt_p = anova(m.iv0, m.iv1)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
  ps_minus1sd = 100 * mean(plogis(eta.q - sd.p)), ps_mean = 100 * mean(plogis(eta.q)),
  ps_plus1sd = 100 * mean(plogis(eta.q + sd.p)),
  n = nrow(iv), n_ppt = n_distinct(iv$participant_id))
as.data.frame(id_variance)

ame <- function(m, term) { f <- fitted(m); co <- summary(m)$coefficients[term, ]
  tibble(term = term, b = co[1], se = co[2], z = co[3], p = co[4], pp = 100 * co[1] * mean(f * (1 - f))) }
m.gender <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ female +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
                  data = iv %>% filter(gender %in% c("f", "m")) %>% mutate(female = gender == "f", cell = droplevels(cell)),
                  family = binomial, control = GL_CTRL)
m.native <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ native +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
                  data = iv %>% mutate(native = native_english == "True"), family = binomial, control = GL_CTRL)
iv4 <- trials %>% filter(experiment == "E4", participant_persuader_disagree) %>% id_cov() %>%
  left_join(p.demo, by = "participant_id") %>% mutate(age10 = age / 10)
m.age <- glmer(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ age10 + interaction_type +", ID_RHS_BASE, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
               data = iv4, family = binomial, control = GL_CTRL)
m.age.cc <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ age10 + interaction_type +", ID_RHS_BASE, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")), data = iv4)
m.gender.cc <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ female +", ID_RHS, "+ (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)")),
                    data = iv %>% filter(gender %in% c("f", "m")) %>% mutate(female = gender == "f", cell = droplevels(cell)))
id_demographics <- bind_rows(
  ame(m.gender, "femaleTRUE") %>% mutate(sample = "E1-E4 LLM, women vs men"),
  ame(m.native, "nativeTRUE") %>% mutate(sample = "E1-E4 LLM, native English"),
  ame(m.age, "age10") %>% mutate(sample = "E4 (LLM + human), per decade of age"))
as.data.frame(id_demographics)
summary(m.gender.cc)$coefficients["femaleTRUE", ]
summary(m.age.cc)$coefficients["age10", ]
iv %>% filter(gender %in% c("f", "m")) %>% group_by(experiment, gender) %>%
  summarize(ps = mean(persuader_success), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
write.csv(id_variance, "stats/id_variance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(id_demographics, "stats/id_demographics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
